the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: two preliminary observations: pseudo-coherence and relative perfectness survive base change, and Ext groups over fibres base change along field extensions, so the vanishing in (1) depends only on the point y of |Y|; over affine Y a universally computing pseudo-coherent L identifies the negative-Ext vanishing locus with a cohomology jump locus of L, open by the jump-loci lemma; etale descent from an affine cover gives openness on general Y; parts (2) and (3) reduce to W = Y, where the claim Rf_{V,*}RSheafHom(K_V, E_V) has no negative cohomology sheaves follows etale locally from L sitting in degrees <= 0, giving (2) via the Ext-to-cohomology identifications; for (3) the simplicial-spaces lemma makes F an fppf sheaf, representability and affineness/finite presentation are etale local, and over affine Y the two-term representative of L exhibits F as the fibre product identifying it with a linear fibre product of affine spaces over Y (source lines 5184-5319)
